run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T07:13:22Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by the checkout service losing all of its ready backends at ~07:13-07:14: the single checkout pod (checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q) is in CrashLoopBackOff with 11 restarts and last termination reason 'Error', exit code 2, and the checkout Service has only a notReadyAddress. frontend's error spans appear exactly on the checkout path (POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, tcp.connect) and nowhere else, reaching 5.47% of frontend span calls by 07:25. frontend itself is healthy (1/1 ready, 0 restarts) and frontend-proxy error spans rise in step, consistent with failing checkout requests. What the checkout container actually dies of at startup is not determinable from the available evidence: container logs for the crashed instances are unavailable, Jaeger data ends ~07:06 (before the failures), and change history is not an integrated source. The kubelet event 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' first at 07:12:15 is a lead, not a proven cause.

claims.text: frontend error-status spans were 0 in every window up to and including the 5-minute window ending 07:12:00, first became nonzero in the window ending 07:14:00 (74.4 spans) and rose to 232 (07:15), 390 (07:16), 591 (07:17), 666 (07:18), 757 (07:20) and 544 (07:25). This onset matches the reported alert start 07:13:22.

frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path: in the 20-minute window ending 07:20 they appear on span_name POST (258 per 5 min at 07:20), POST /api/checkout (258), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (258), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (258) and tcp.connect (24.6), while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds stayed at 0.
At 07:25:00 the ratio of frontend error-status spans to all frontend spans over the preceding 5 minutes was 0.0547 (5.47%).

frontend-proxy error-status spans rose from a pre-incident level of roughly 1-4 per 5 minutes (all windows 06:50-07:12) to 37.8 (07:14), 111 (07:15), 193 (07:16), 289 (07:17), 331 (07:18), 374 (07:20) and 356.7 (07:25).
The checkout Deployment reports spec replicas 1 but no readyReplicas and no availableReplicas, i.e. zero available backends.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (owner ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb) is phase Running but ready=false with condition ContainersNotReady since 07:19:15; its checkout container is in state waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff and message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout', restartCount 11, and lastState terminated with reason 'Error', exitCode 2, startedAt 07:19:10, finishedAt 07:19:15.

Kubelet events for checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q include 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (Normal/Killing, count 7, first 07:12:15, last 07:15:15) and 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout' (Warning/BackOff, count 26, first 07:14:15, last 07:20:03); Created/Started events for the checkout container fired 7 times between 06:37:06 and 07:15:10. No Evicted or OOM event was returned.

The checkout Service's Endpoints object contains only a notReadyAddresses entry (pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, ip 100.96.4.26, node i-01375feffdca65277, port tcp-service 8080); there is no ready address for checkout.

checkout's own span volume (server and producer spans) was steady at 146-179 per 5 minutes until the window ending 07:14:00 (146.7), then fell to 102 (07:15), 64 (07:16), 29 (07:17) and 0 from the window ending 07:18:00 onward, showing checkout stopped serving at approximately 07:14; its client-span volume fell from ~1700 per 5 minutes to 0 over the same period.

No Deployment rollout of checkout occurred during the incident: only one checkout ReplicaSet exists (checkout-5dccddf8bb, created 06:35:33, owned by Deployment checkout) with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, and the Deployment's generation is 1 with observedGeneration 1.

The checkout container spec is image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with limits cpu 250m / memory 512Mi, requests cpu 50m / memory 128Mi, env GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, and it defines no livenessProbe and no readinessProbe; the only init container is busybox 'wait-for-kafka'.

The checkout pod's container memory working-set maximum stayed far below its limit: 27,897,856 bytes (window ending 06:53:45), 30,552,064 (06:58:45), 40,497,152 (07:03:45) and 45,432,832 (07:08:45) against a 512Mi limit, and the container's last termination reason is 'Error', not OOMKilled.

All other 20 pods in namespace otel-demo are Running with restartCount 0 and ready=true, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-c8ks2, payment-55766d76b9-rlrgr, cart-755465879b-7khmf, product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8, kafka-ff7884766-svvv8, flagd-d8946b599-m4jww and otel-collector-564d9c7987-sxzfd; checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is the only pod with a nonzero restart count or ready=false.

Error-status span series in 06:13:22-07:25:00 exist only for service_name frontend, frontend-proxy, payment, accounting, recommendation, fraud-detection and ad; no error-status span series was returned for checkout, cart, currency, email, shipping, product-catalog, quote or image-provider.
payment's error-span counters show an increase of exactly 0 in every 5-minute window from 06:50:00 to 07:25:00, and its pod payment-55766d76b9-rlrgr is ready with 0 restarts.

All five cluster nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False, including i-01375feffdca65277 which hosts the checkout pod; node allocatable is 4 CPU and about 15.5-16 GB memory.
GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB is not unique to checkout: product-catalog also sets GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB (and is ready with 0 restarts); flagd sets 60MiB and otel-collector 240MiB, while other deployments set none.

flagd had its own rollout: ReplicaSet flagd-c47676d99 (created 06:35:33, 0 replicas) was superseded by flagd-d8946b599 (created 06:37:14, 1 replica ready), roughly 36 minutes before the frontend error onset at ~07:13.

The most supported cause of the frontend alert is the checkout service being fully unavailable: checkout stopped emitting spans at ~07:14, its Deployment has 0 ready/available replicas, and its single pod is in CrashLoopBackOff with exit code 2, so frontend's PlaceOrder calls fail at the transport level (tcp.connect) and surface as POST /api/checkout errors. The op-level error distribution and the matching onset (~07:13-07:14) tie the frontend errors to the checkout path rather than to any other frontend dependency.

The deepest trigger the evidence hints at is an in-place change to the checkout container definition at 07:12:15 ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted', first occurrence 07:12:15, immediately before the first frontend error window), after which every checkout container start lasted only seconds and exited with code 2 (e.g. started 07:19:10, finished 07:19:15). This is unproven: the content of the change and the application's startup error/panic message could not be read, because no container logs exist for the crashed instances and change history is not an integrated source.

This is not a frontend-wide failure: frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg is ready with 0 restarts, and frontend's error spans are limited to checkout-path operations while GET /api/data, GET /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds recorded 0 error spans in the same window.

Rejected: a payment service fault caused the checkout/frontend failures. payment's error-span increase is 0 in every 5-minute window from 06:50 to 07:25, its pod is ready with 0 restarts, and it produced no new error activity during the incident; its error-status series existed but were flat.

Rejected: the checkout pod was OOMKilled or hit its memory limit. Its container's last termination reason is 'Error' with exitCode 2 (not OOMKilled), and its memory working set peaked at about 45.4 MB against a 512Mi limit; no Evicted or OOM event was returned for the pod.

Rejected: a checkout Deployment rollout or image change introduced the failure. Only one checkout ReplicaSet exists (created 06:35:33), the pod runs the same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout as the ReplicaSet/Deployment, and the Deployment generation is 1.

Rejected: node-level resource pressure or a cluster-wide disruption caused the pod failure. All five nodes are Ready with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure False, and every other pod in otel-demo is ready with 0 restarts.

Retrieve the crashed checkout container's own output (kubectl logs checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q -n otel-demo --previous and the kubelet/node journal for exit code 2 at 07:19:15) to name the exact panic/startup error before attributing the crash to a specific cause.

Diff the live checkout Pod spec against the checkout Deployment template (Deployment is generation 1, unchanged since 06:35:33) to find what the 07:12:15 in-place container definition change was, and revert it; deleting the pod would let ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb recreate it from the unchanged Deployment template.

gaps: No application logs are available for the incident window: fetch_pod_logs returned zero lines for 07:10:00-07:31:37 for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, payment-55766d76b9-rlrgr, cart-755465879b-7khmf, product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8 and kafka-ff7884766-svvv8, and the checkout container's readable output ends around 06:57-06:58 with no 'previous' instance available. The startup error that produced exit code 2 is therefore unknown.

The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so what modified the checkout container definition at 07:12:15 ('Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted') cannot be verified, and the current Deployment spec (generation 1) does not reflect any change.

Jaeger trace data ends before the failures (the checkout trace search covered only ~07:06:04-07:06:17), so no error-detail spans exist for the 07:13+ failing PlaceOrder calls; the gRPC status/error text of the frontend failures is unknown.

No alerting rule named RequestErrorRate, and no alerting rules at all, are loaded in this Prometheus target (both rule queries returned no data), so the alert expression, its threshold and the unit of the annotation value 'current: 3.4999999999999996' could not be verified.

checkout runs a single replica with no readiness/liveness probe, so there is no healthy sibling or probe history to compare against, and the exact time the crash loop started cannot be pinned more precisely than the events (first Killing 07:12:15) and the span-volume drop (~07:14).
next_steps: Collect `kubectl logs -n otel-demo checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q --previous` (and the node's containerd/kubelet logs around 07:19:15) from the cluster to read the actual startup error or Go panic behind exit code 2.

Pull the change/audit record for the otel-demo checkout Pod (and its container definition) around 2026-11-15T07:12:15Z from the change-management/GitOps source, and compare it with the Deployment template.
Verify whether the checkout pod's live spec (env/resources) differs from Deployment checkout and, if so, revert and recreate the pod so ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb starts a clean instance.
Add a readiness probe and a crash-loop/availability alert on Deployment checkout so a single-replica checkout outage is detected directly, not only through frontend's error rate.
